releases.summary: Milestone release completing desktop repository mapping, identity detection, UI polish, structured navigation, and repository-local Git identity cleanup across CLI and desktop flows.

features.title: Desktop repository bindings
features.description: Added desktop repository binding management with repository selection, identity assignment, binding updates, and removal actions

features.title: Desktop identity detection and sync
features.description: Added desktop identity detection for repository and workspace paths, showing the effective bgit identity and allowing Git config sync from the UI

features.title: Desktop interaction polish
features.description: Improved desktop spacing, alignment, copy actions, truncation, active-state highlighting, hover states, and smoother refresh behavior without changing backend logic

features.title: Desktop structured navigation
features.description: Reorganized the desktop app into dedicated Dashboard, Identities, Repository Bindings, Backup & Restore, and Doctor pages with sticky sidebar navigation

fixes.title: Repo-local Git identity consistency
fixes.description: Bound repositories are now re-synced on identity activation and update, binding removal clears stale local Git identity, and deleting an identity removes dependent bindings/workspaces and clears affected repositories

fixes.title: Scriptable confirmation flows
fixes.description: CLI yes/no confirmation prompts now accept non-TTY input so automated validation and scripted flows work reliably

fixes.title: Desktop binding cleanup parity
fixes.description: Desktop binding removal and identity deletion now follow the same repository-local Git cleanup behavior as the CLI

fixes.title: Desktop identity workflow clarity
fixes.description: Desktop add/view flows now show SSH public keys directly and guide users to add generated keys to GitHub

fixes.title: Desktop doctor and responsive cleanup
fixes.description: Doctor page duplication was removed and desktop layouts were tightened for smaller window sizes

releases.summary: Milestone release expanding the desktop app with native feedback, encrypted backup and restore, SSH public key copy support, and GitHub avatar identity cards.

features.title: Desktop notification system
features.description: Desktop identity actions now use app-native success, warning, and error notifications, confirmation dialogs, and action loading states

features.title: Desktop backup and restore
features.description: Added desktop UI for encrypted .bgit export and import using the existing core archive format, file selection dialogs, password prompts, and restore summaries

features.title: Desktop SSH public key copy
features.description: Identity rows now show SSH public key previews with a copy action so users can add generated keys to GitHub without manually opening key files

features.title: GitHub avatar identity cards
features.description: Desktop identity rows now show GitHub avatars derived from configured GitHub usernames with initials fallback

fixes.title: Clearer desktop destructive actions
fixes.description: Identity deletion and backup import now use explicit in-app confirmation dialogs with safety warnings

fixes.title: Actionable desktop error feedback
fixes.description: Common backend, config, SSH, and identity failures now surface clearer user-facing hints in the desktop app

releases.summary: Patch release fixing bound repository Git identity enforcement so normal git commits use the repository's bound bgit identity.

fixes.title: Repo-local Git identity for bound repositories
fixes.description: bgit bind now writes repository-local user.name and user.email for the bound identity so normal git commit uses the correct author even when the global active identity differs

fixes.title: Bound repository safety checks
fixes.description: bgit check now validates the effective repository Git identity and allows a bound repository to pass when its local Git identity matches the binding

fixes.title: Sync repair for bound repositories
fixes.description: bgit sync --fix now repairs repo-local Git identity for bound repositories instead of requiring a global identity switch

releases.summary: Release packaging update for the Phase 7 desktop beta, adding Linux desktop artifact generation to the GitHub release workflow.

features.title: Linux desktop release artifact
features.description: The GitHub release workflow now builds the Wails desktop application on Linux and uploads bgit-desktop-linux-amd64 alongside the CLI binaries

fixes.title: Desktop asset release coverage
fixes.description: Ensures the desktop beta binary is attached to the GitHub release instead of shipping only CLI binaries

fixes.title: Release workflow dependencies
fixes.description: Installs the required Linux GTK, WebKit, Soup, Node, and Wails dependencies before building the desktop artifact

releases.summary: Beta milestone release introducing the Wails desktop app foundation, identity dashboard, identity management, and visual diagnostics.

features.title: Desktop app foundation
features.description: Added a Wails desktop application under desktop/ with a separate entrypoint and backend bindings while preserving the existing CLI entrypoint

features.title: Desktop identity dashboard
features.description: Added a desktop dashboard for configured identities, active profile, setup state, identity counts, SSH key status, and effective identity source

features.title: Desktop identity management
features.description: Added desktop actions to add, edit, activate, and delete bgit identities using the existing core identity and SSH flows

features.title: Desktop doctor integration
features.description: Added read-only desktop diagnostics for config health, SSH setup, SSH agent state, and Git identity alignment

fixes.title: Desktop project structure cleanup
fixes.description: Moved active Wails configuration under desktop/ and removed obsolete manual Windows installer documentation from the release structure

fixes.title: Beta release metadata
fixes.description: Prepared release metadata for v0.7.0-beta and marks beta releases as prereleases in the GitHub release workflow

releases.summary: Milestone release adding encrypted bgit export and import archives for portable identity backups.

features.title: BGIT export archive system
features.description: Added bgit export to package the current bgit backup payload into a stable .bgit archive structure

features.title: Encrypted export layer
features.description: Wrapped .bgit archives in an encrypted envelope using Argon2id key derivation and AES-256-GCM payload encryption

features.title: BGIT import restore flow
features.description: Added bgit import to decrypt encrypted .bgit archives, validate the archived config, and restore it atomically

features.title: Portable SSH key backup support
features.description: Encrypted .bgit backups now include configured identity SSH private and public keys under payload/keys so backups can be imported on another machine without regenerating keys

features.title: Backup portability validation
features.description: Added a Machine A to Machine B portability test that verifies identities, active user, SSH key files, target-machine key paths, and regenerated SSH config entries

fixes.title: Password-only interactive archive protection
fixes.description: Export and import passwords are prompted interactively and are not accepted through command-line arguments

fixes.title: Export password recovery warning
fixes.description: bgit export now warns users that the archive password is required for import and cannot be recovered if forgotten

fixes.title: Target-machine SSH key path restore
fixes.description: Import rewrites restored SSH key paths to the target machine and regenerates bgit-managed SSH config entries after restoring keys

fixes.title: Encrypted archive integration coverage
fixes.description: Integration tests now cover encrypted export creation, unreadable plaintext archive checks, wrong-password import failure, corrupted and empty archive rejection, and successful import restore

releases.summary: Milestone release focused on shared core models, standardized core responses, safer config persistence, and stronger isolated integration testing.

features.title: Shared core model layer
features.description: Added core/models to hold reusable identity, repository, and operational structs shared across config, identity, repo, and SSH modules

features.title: Standardized core result objects
features.description: Core identity, repo, and SSH operations now return structured result objects instead of mixed tuple-style responses

features.title: Safer config persistence
features.description: Config loads and saves now validate supported versions and references, normalize legacy values, and save atomically via temp-file replacement

features.title: Stronger isolated integration harness
features.description: Integration tests now run with isolated HOME and XDG config paths, explicit Git system-config isolation, clearer failure output, and optional temp-dir preservation

fixes.title: Config validation regressions caught earlier
fixes.description: Integration coverage now includes invalid config version handling, duplicate user rejection, workspace removal, and binding override/no-op paths

fixes.title: More consistent core APIs
fixes.description: Core consumers now work against predictable result shapes, reducing command-layer branching and special-case handling

releases.summary: Milestone release that finishes the core extraction and CLI integration work for config, SSH, identity, and repository flows.

features.title: Core config module
features.description: Moved config loading, persistence, migration, and active identity state into core/config as the shared config boundary

features.title: Core SSH module
features.description: Moved SSH key generation, SSH config management, agent helpers, and connectivity checks into core/ssh

features.title: Core identity module
features.description: Moved identity resolution and identity lifecycle operations into core/identity

features.title: Core repository module
features.description: Added core/repo for workspace registration, repository binding, remote URL conversion, clone auto-bind support, and repository owner resolution

fixes.title: Thinner CLI command layer
fixes.description: Commands now route their core behavior through extracted modules instead of duplicating repo, identity, and remote logic directly

fixes.title: Consistent repository safety decisions
fixes.description: Repository owner detection, remote conversion, and clone binding now use shared core logic across check, remote, clone, bind, and uninstall flows

releases.summary: Bugfix release focused on uninstall recovery, post-uninstall safety, and repeatable integration testing.

features.title: Docker-backed integration test harness
features.description: Added repeatable host and Docker integration tests covering setup, identity flows, remote fixes, safety checks, and uninstall cleanup

features.title: Real-account acceptance test harness
features.description: Added an opt-in real-account test flow that backs up and restores real bgit, SSH, and Git state while validating selected identities and repositories

fixes.title: Uninstall recovery for existing users
fixes.description: Resolved GitHub issue #5 reported by maheshmthorat: uninstall now restores configured repo remotes first, removes managed SSH config, restores or clears bgit-managed hooks, and restores backed-up Git identity when available so GitHub Desktop and normal Git commands are not left affected after uninstall

fixes.title: Post-uninstall read-only safety
fixes.description: Read-only commands such as list, status, active, prompt, and doctor no longer recreate ~/.bgit or reinstall hooks after uninstall

fixes.title: Optional SSH key cleanup
fixes.description: Added bgit uninstall --remove-keys so SSH key deletion is explicit instead of implicit

releases.summary: Phase 3 usability and safety release focused on one-time setup and automatic push protection.

features.title: One-time setup command
features.description: Added bgit setup to initialize configuration, install global pre-push safety checks, and prepare defaults

features.title: Automatic push safety checks
features.description: Added bgit check and managed pre-push hook integration to validate identity and remote alignment

features.title: Shell prompt integration
features.description: Added prompt-friendly identity output for shell integrations

features.title: Clone auto-bind by default
features.description: Repositories cloned with bgit clone are automatically bound to the effective identity by default

fixes.title: Consistent first-run behavior
fixes.description: Commands now trigger setup flow automatically when bgit has not been initialized

fixes.title: Uninstall cleanup
fixes.description: Uninstall now clears managed global hooks path and removes managed SSH config entries

breaking_changes.title: Legacy command deprecations
breaking_changes.description: bgit init and bgit setup-ssh are deprecated in favor of bgit setup; bgit remote fix is now legacy/advanced guidance

releases.summary: Code cleanup and improved installation experience.

features.title: Dynamic version fetching
features.description: Install scripts now automatically fetch the latest version from GitHub

fixes.title: Standardized user prompts
fixes.description: All confirmation prompts now use consistent UI patterns

fixes.title: Code cleanup
fixes.description: Removed unnecessary comments and improved code readability

releases.summary: Phase 2 release with workspace support and diagnostics.

features.title: Workspace management
features.description: Create organized workspace folders with automatic identity binding

features.title: Repository binding
features.description: Bind individual repositories to specific identities

features.title: Identity status
features.description: Show current identity status and bindings

features.title: Diagnostics
features.description: Diagnose and auto-fix configuration issues

features.title: Active identity
features.description: Show current active identity

features.title: Identity resolution
features.description: Automatic identity resolution based on workspace > binding > global priority

releases.summary: Initial release with core identity management features.

features.title: Multi-user identity management
features.description: Add, list, use, and delete Git identities

features.title: SSH key management
features.description: Generate or import SSH keys for each identity

features.title: Git config handling
features.description: Automatic user.name and user.email configuration

features.title: Clone with identity
features.description: Clone repositories with the correct SSH configuration

features.title: Remote management
features.description: Fix and restore remote URLs for bgit compatibility

features.title: Configuration sync
features.description: Validate and sync bgit configuration

features.title: Safe uninstall
features.description: Safely uninstall bgit and restore all repositories

features.title: Cross-platform support
features.description: Works on Linux, macOS, and Windows
